fusions.name: Churned Wake
fusions.desc: Drives a cone of water 5 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything in it. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gallop Strike
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 7 tiles to the target and strikes it for 16 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at the full 6 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Shared Load
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, spare arms take up the load and you regain 3 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
